name: Duel
description: Locks an adjacent enemy into single combat for %duration% turns. Neither unit may act, and each is forced to attack the other at the end of its turn. The survivor permanently gains %duel_bonus% to every attribute and heals %duel_heal:pct%% of its maximum health, multiplied by %win_multiplier% if the loser was more than a basic unit. Separating the duellists ends it early with no reward.
